summary: Iteration 16 - Tirage du Jour Integration & French Accents Verification. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend TirageDuJour component renders correctly on homepage with 'Carte du Jour', French date format (04 mars 2026), GRATUIT badge, and reveal button. Card reveal shows full arcane details (name, orientation, element, planet, keywords, interpretation, message énergie).
